# FaceClock

> FaceClock is a free Android app for employee time tracking that uses on-device face recognition. It works fully offline, stores all data locally on the device, and does not require any cloud or internet connection.

FaceClock is open source and distributed via Google Play. The app is designed for small businesses, workshops, and teams that need a simple way to track work shifts using face recognition without sending biometric data anywhere.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android (phones, tablets, Chromebooks)
- Package ID: io.github.eslazarev.faceclock
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.github.eslazarev.faceclock
- Source code and project page: https://github.com/eslazarev/faceclock
- License: free of charge on Google Play
- Privacy model: 100% on-device, no cloud, no analytics, no network calls for face data
- Data storage: local Room (SQLite) database; photos stored on the device's internal storage
- Data retention: shifts and photos older than 90 days are automatically removed by a background WorkManager job
- Languages: English, Russian

## Features

- Face check-in / check-out with live camera preview and a single Capture button
- On-device face detection and recognition (no biometric data leaves the device)
- Automatic suggested action (In/Out) that can auto-trigger after a configurable timeout
- Shift logic: if the last shift is closed -> check-in; if open longer than Max shift hours -> start new shift; otherwise -> check-out
- Employee management: add, rename, delete; photos and embeddings stay local
- Shift history with in/out photos and durations
- CSV export of shift history
- Configurable settings: Max shift hours, default dialog timeout, Keep screen on, app language
